1//! Drawing to a non-page context.
2//!
3//! In 90% of the cases, you will not have to use streams. In most cases,
4//! all you need to do when using this crate is to first construct a document,
5//! and then add new pages to the document and use the [`Page::surface`] method to get
6//! access to the drawing context. However, there are cases when you don't want to
7//! draw on the main page surface, but instead you want to create a "sub-surface"
8//! where you can draw independently of the main page contents. This is what streams
9//! are there for. Currently, there are only two situations where you need to do that:
10//!
11//! - When using masks and defining the contents of the mask.
12//! - When using a pattern fill or stroke and defining the contents of the pattern.
13//!
14//! If you want to do any of the two above, you need to call the [`Surface::stream_builder`] method
15//! of the current surface. The stream builder represents a kind of sub-context that is
16//! independent of the main surface you are working with. Once you have a stream builder, you
17//! can once again invoke the [`StreamBuilder::surface`] method, and use this new surface to define the contents
18//! of your mask/pattern. In the end, you can call [`StreamBuilder::finish`] which will return a [`Stream`] object.
19//! This [`Stream`] object contains the encoded instructions of the mask/pattern, which you can
20//! then use to create new [`Pattern`]/[`Mask`] objects.
21//!
22//! [`Page::surface`]: crate::page::Page::surface
23//! [`Surface::stream_builder`]: crate::surface::Surface::stream_builder
24//! [`Pattern`]: crate::graphics::paint::Pattern
25//! [`Mask`]: crate::graphics::mask::Mask
26

42/// A stream.
43///
44/// See the module description for an explanation of its purpose.
45// The only reason we implement clone for this type is that in some cases,
46// we might need to clone a pattern (including its stream)
47#[derive(Debug, Hash, Eq, PartialEq, Clone)]
48pub struct Stream {
49    pub(crate) content: Vec<u8>,
50    pub(crate) bbox: Rect,
51    // Important: Each object that uses a stream must ensure to pass on the validation
52    // errors to the `SerializeContext` at some point. Currently, only `Mask`,
53    // `TilingPattern`, `InternalPage` and `XObject` require that.
54    pub(crate) validation_errors: Vec<ValidationError>,
55    pub(crate) resource_dictionary: ResourceDictionary,
56}
57
58impl Stream {
59    pub(crate) fn new(
60        content: Vec<u8>,
61        bbox: Rect,
62        validation_errors: Vec<ValidationError>,
63        resource_dictionary: ResourceDictionary,
64    ) -> Self {
65        Self {
66            content,
67            bbox,
68            validation_errors,
69            resource_dictionary,
70        }
71    }
72
73    pub(crate) fn is_empty(&self) -> bool {
74        self.content.is_empty()
75    }
76
77    pub(crate) fn empty() -> Self {
78        Self {
79            content: vec![],
80            bbox: Rect::from_xywh(0.0, 0.0, 0.0, 0.0).unwrap(),
81            validation_errors: vec![],
82            resource_dictionary: ResourceDictionaryBuilder::new().finish(),
83        }
84    }
85}

87/// A builder to create streams.
88pub struct StreamBuilder<'a> {
89    sc: &'a mut SerializeContext,
90    stream: Stream,
91}
92
93impl<'a> StreamBuilder<'a> {
94    pub(crate) fn new(sc: &'a mut SerializeContext) -> Self {
95        Self {
96            sc,
97            stream: Stream::empty(),
98        }
99    }
100
101    /// Get the surface of the stream builder.
102    pub fn surface(&mut self) -> Surface<'_> {
103        // Stream builders cannot have any tags since we always pass a dummy
104        // identifier. Only main page content streams can have one.
105        let finish_fn = Box::new(|stream, _| {
106            self.stream = stream;
107        });
108
109        Surface::new(
110            self.sc,
111            ContentBuilder::new(Transform::identity(), true),
112            None,
113            finish_fn,
114        )
115    }
116
117    /// Turn the stream builder into a stream.
118    pub fn finish(self) -> Stream {
119        self.stream
120    }
121}

123/// A PDF stream filter.
124#[derive(Debug, Copy, Clone)]
125pub(crate) enum StreamFilter {
126    Flate,
127    FlateMemoized,
128    AsciiHex,
129    Dct,
130}
131
132impl StreamFilter {
133    pub(crate) fn to_name(self) -> Name<'static> {
134        match self {
135            Self::AsciiHex => Name(b"ASCIIHexDecode"),
136            Self::Flate => Name(b"FlateDecode"),
137            Self::FlateMemoized => Name(b"FlateDecode"),
138            Self::Dct => Name(b"DCTDecode"),
139        }
140    }
141
142    pub(crate) fn is_binary(&self) -> bool {
143        match self {
144            StreamFilter::Flate => true,
145            StreamFilter::FlateMemoized => true,
146            StreamFilter::AsciiHex => false,
147            StreamFilter::Dct => true,
148        }
149    }
150}
151
152impl StreamFilter {
153    #[track_caller]
154    pub(crate) fn apply(&self, content: &[u8]) -> Vec<u8> {
155        match self {
156            StreamFilter::Flate => deflate_encode(content),
157            StreamFilter::FlateMemoized => deflate_encode_memoized(content),
158            StreamFilter::AsciiHex => hex_encode(content),
159            // Note: We don't actually encode manually with DCT, because
160            // this is only used for JPEG images which are already encoded,
161            // so this shouldn't be called at all.
162            StreamFilter::Dct => panic!("can't apply dct decode"),
163        }
164    }
165}

167/// Allows us to keep track of the filters that a stream has and
168/// apply them in an orderly fashion.
169#[derive(Debug, Clone)]
170pub(crate) enum StreamFilters {
171    None,
172    Single(StreamFilter),
173    Multiple(Vec<StreamFilter>),
174}
175
176impl StreamFilters {
177    pub(crate) fn add(&mut self, stream_filter: StreamFilter) {
178        match self {
179            StreamFilters::None => *self = StreamFilters::Single(stream_filter),
180            StreamFilters::Single(cur) => {
181                *self = StreamFilters::Multiple(vec![*cur, stream_filter])
182            }
183            StreamFilters::Multiple(cur) => cur.push(stream_filter),
184        }
185    }
186
187    pub(crate) fn is_binary(&self) -> bool {
188        match self {
189            StreamFilters::None => false,
190            StreamFilters::Single(s) => s.is_binary(),
191            StreamFilters::Multiple(m) => m.last().unwrap().is_binary(),
192        }
193    }
194}
195
196pub(crate) struct FilterStreamBuilder<'a> {
197    content: Cow<'a, [u8]>,
198    filters: StreamFilters,
199}
200
201impl<'a> FilterStreamBuilder<'a> {
202    fn empty(content: &'a [u8]) -> Self {
203        Self {
204            content: Cow::Borrowed(content),
205            filters: StreamFilters::None,
206        }
207    }
208
209    pub(crate) fn new_from_content_stream(
210        content: &'a [u8],
211        serialize_settings: &SerializeSettings,
212    ) -> Self {
213        let mut filter_stream = Self::empty(content);
214
215        if serialize_settings.compress_content_streams {
216            filter_stream.add_filter(StreamFilter::FlateMemoized);
217        }
218
219        filter_stream
220    }
221
222    pub(crate) fn new_from_deflated(content: &'a [u8]) -> Self {
223        let mut filter_stream = Self::empty(content);
224        filter_stream.add_unapplied_filter(StreamFilter::Flate);
225
226        filter_stream
227    }
228
229    pub(crate) fn new_from_binary_data(content: &'a [u8]) -> Self {
230        let mut filter_stream = Self::empty(content);
231        filter_stream.add_filter(StreamFilter::Flate);
232
233        filter_stream
234    }
235
236    pub(crate) fn new_auto_compressed(content: &'a [u8]) -> Self {
237        let filter_stream = Self::new_from_binary_data(content);
238
239        const MAX_COMPRESSED_SIZE: usize = 75;
240        if 100 * filter_stream.content.len() / content.len() > MAX_COMPRESSED_SIZE {
241            return Self::empty(content);
242        }
243
244        filter_stream
245    }
246
247    pub(crate) fn new_from_uncompressed(content: &'a [u8]) -> Self {
248        Self::empty(content)
249    }
250
251    pub(crate) fn new_from_jpeg_data(content: &'a [u8]) -> Self {
252        let mut filter_stream = Self::empty(content);
253        // JPEG data already is DCT encoded.
254        filter_stream.add_unapplied_filter(StreamFilter::Dct);
255
256        filter_stream
257    }
258
259    pub(crate) fn finish(mut self, serialize_settings: &SerializeSettings) -> FilterStream<'a> {
260        if serialize_settings.ascii_compatible && self.filters.is_binary() {
261            self.add_filter(StreamFilter::AsciiHex);
262        }
263
264        FilterStream {
265            content: self.content,
266            filters: self.filters,
267        }
268    }
269
270    fn add_filter(&mut self, filter: StreamFilter) {
271        self.content = Cow::Owned(filter.apply(&self.content));
272        self.filters.add(filter);
273    }
274
275    fn add_unapplied_filter(&mut self, filter: StreamFilter) {
276        self.filters.add(filter);
277    }
278}
279
280pub(crate) struct FilterStream<'a> {
281    content: Cow<'a, [u8]>,
282    filters: StreamFilters,
283}
284
285impl FilterStream<'_> {
286    pub(crate) fn encoded_data(&self) -> &[u8] {
287        &self.content
288    }
289
290    pub(crate) fn write_filters<'b, T>(&self, mut dict: T)
291    where
292        T: DerefMut<Target = Dict<'b>>,
293    {
294        match &self.filters {
295            StreamFilters::None => {}
296            StreamFilters::Single(filter) => {
297                dict.deref_mut().pair(Name(b"Filter"), filter.to_name());
298            }
299            StreamFilters::Multiple(filters) => {
300                dict.deref_mut()
301                    .insert(Name(b"Filter"))
302                    .start::<Array>()
303                    .items(filters.iter().map(|f| f.to_name()).rev());
304            }
305        }
306    }
307}

309#[cfg_attr(feature = "comemo", comemo::memoize)]
310fn deflate_encode_memoized(data: &[u8]) -> Vec<u8> {
311    deflate_encode(data)
312}
313
314pub(crate) fn deflate_encode(data: &[u8]) -> Vec<u8> {
315    use std::io::Write;
316
317    const COMPRESSION_LEVEL: u8 = 6;
318    let mut e = ZlibEncoder::new(Vec::new(), Compression::new(COMPRESSION_LEVEL as u32));
319    e.write_all(data).unwrap();
320    e.finish().unwrap()
321}
322
323fn hex_encode(data: &[u8]) -> Vec<u8> {
324    use std::fmt::Write;
325
326    const COLUMNS: usize = 35;
327    let len = data.len();
328    let capacity = 2 * len + len / COLUMNS;
329    let mut output = String::with_capacity(capacity);
330    for (index, byte) in data.iter().enumerate() {
331        write!(output, "{byte:02X}").unwrap();
332        if index % COLUMNS == COLUMNS - 1 {
333            output.push('\n');
334        }
335    }
336    output.into_bytes()
337}
